page.layout: Printed page with a page number at top right (35). Left margin carries vertical side labels "Articuli Multiplices" / "Num. sing." and "Articuli Multiplices / Num. plur." set sideways, with declension paradigm blocks (brace-grouped) beside them. Main text: paradigm lines of the singular feminine articles, then plural feminine paradigm, then a centred heading "Articuli conjuncti cum alijs Praepositionibus.", then two brace-grouped lists headed Ne and Per, and at the foot a catchword "Con".

main_text.p: Articuli Mulie- bres. Num. sing.Nominatiuo. La, die, hæc.
Genitiuo. Dela vel della, der, huius.
Datiuo. alla vel a la, der, huic.
Accusatiuo. La, die, hanc.
Vocatiuo. O. O. O jhr.
Ablatiuo. dalla vel dala, von der, abhac.
Articuli Mulie- bres. Num. plur.Nominatiu. Le, die, hæ.
Genitiuo. delle, vel dele, deren, harum.
Datiuo. alle vel ale, denen, his.
Accusatiuo Le, die, has.
Vocatiuo. O. O, O jhr.
Ablatiuo. dalle. oder da le, von den.
main_text.head: Articuli conjuncti cum alijs Præpositionibus.
main_text.p: NeNello, nel, in den.
Nelli, negli, nei ne, in denen.
Nella, in der.
Neile, in denen.
PerPer lo, pel, pello, durch den,
Per li, pergli, pelli, per i, pei, pe, durch die.
Per la, durch die, durch sie.
Per le, durch die (Weiber) donne.)

page.notes: Side labels and brace groupings in the margins are described, not transcribed in full. The marginal Gothic-style words and the paradigm lines are approximate in places due to scan quality; the word "Ne" and "Per" are brace labels. Some text near the paradigm is faint.
